MESSAGE: 🔄 Refresh (top right) reloads everything fresh; the page also quietly re-syncs itself in the background.
SW-MESSAGE: 🔄 Refresh (juu kulia) hupakia upya kila kitu; ukurasa pia hujisasisha wenyewe chinichini.

MESSAGE: 🖱️ Click any column header to sort that table; click it again to reverse the order.
SW-MESSAGE: 🖱️ Bofya kichwa cha safu yoyote kupanga jedwali; bofya tena kubadilisha mpangilio.

MESSAGE: 🔍 The magnifier (top right) searches customers by name, REF# or phone across the whole system.
SW-MESSAGE: 🔍 Kioo cha kukuza (juu kulia) hutafuta wateja kwa jina, REF# au namba ya simu katika mfumo mzima.

MESSAGE: 📥 Every card has its OWN Excel, JPG and CSV buttons — they export that table exactly as you have filtered it.
SW-MESSAGE: 📥 Kila kadi ina vitufe VYAKE vya Excel, JPG na CSV — hupakua jedwali hilo kama ulivyolichuja.

MESSAGE: 📷 The JPG button turns a single table or chart into a picture — ready for WhatsApp or a report.
SW-MESSAGE: 📷 Kitufe cha JPG hugeuza jedwali au chati moja kuwa picha — tayari kwa WhatsApp au ripoti.

MESSAGE: 🌓 The sun/moon button switches light and dark mode — your choice is remembered on this device.
SW-MESSAGE: 🌓 Kitufe cha jua/mwezi hubadilisha hali ya mwanga na giza — chaguo lako hukumbukwa kwenye kifaa hiki.

MESSAGE: 🇹🇿 The EN/SW button switches the language of the whole portal.
SW-MESSAGE: 🇹🇿 Kitufe cha EN/SW hubadilisha lugha ya mfumo mzima.

MESSAGE: ☎️ Phone numbers everywhere are clickable — tap to call the customer or guarantor directly.
SW-MESSAGE: ☎️ Namba za simu kila mahali zinabofyeka — gusa kupiga simu kwa mteja au mdhamini moja kwa moja.

MESSAGE: 🔢 Every table carries an S/N column, so a row can be read out in a meeting without counting.
SW-MESSAGE: 🔢 Kila jedwali lina safu ya S/N, hivyo mstari unaweza kutajwa kwenye kikao bila kuhesabu.

MESSAGE: 📊 The dashboard is built from today's uploads — current defaulters, expected repayments, approved loans and received payments.
SW-MESSAGE: 📊 Dashibodi hujengwa kutoka upakiaji wa leo — wadaiwa wa sasa, marejesho yanayotarajiwa, mikopo iliyoidhinishwa na malipo yaliyopokelewa.

MESSAGE: 🎯 "Sales this week" counts only loans whose APPROVED DATE falls inside this week, measured against the weekly company target.
SW-MESSAGE: 🎯 "Sales this week" huhesabu mikopo tu ambayo APPROVED DATE yake iko ndani ya wiki hii, ikilinganishwa na lengo la wiki la kampuni.

MESSAGE: 🔴 In the officer boards, a red % means below the group average — an instant view of who needs support.
SW-MESSAGE: 🔴 Katika bodi za maafisa, asilimia nyekundu inamaanisha chini ya wastani wa kikundi — njia ya haraka kuona nani anahitaji msaada.

MESSAGE: 📅 The weekly recovery trend compares each day's initial vs current defaulter arrears; Sat/Sun are recovery-only days.
SW-MESSAGE: 📅 Mwenendo wa urejeshaji wa wiki hulinganisha deni la awali dhidi ya la sasa la wadaiwa kila siku; Jumamosi/Jumapili ni siku za urejeshaji pekee.

MESSAGE: 🧮 Recovery % = recovered ÷ that day's uncollected. On weekends it is measured against the day's initial arrears instead.
SW-MESSAGE: 🧮 Asilimia ya urejeshaji = kilichorejeshwa ÷ kisichokusanywa cha siku hiyo. Wikendi hupimwa dhidi ya deni la awali la siku badala yake.

MESSAGE: ➖ Debt crisis appears on the WEEKLY recovery board only — a customer cannot fall into default between breakfast and lunch.
SW-MESSAGE: ➖ Ongezeko la deni huonekana kwenye bodi ya urejeshaji ya WIKI pekee — mteja hawezi kuingia kwenye deni kati ya asubuhi na mchana.

MESSAGE: ☎️ "Call agents" here means the CUSTOMER SERVICE agents named as CREATED BY on the application reports — only TRACK# 1 customers count.
SW-MESSAGE: ☎️ "Call agents" hapa ni mawakala wa huduma kwa wateja walioandikwa kama CREATED BY kwenye ripoti za maombi — wateja wa TRACK# 1 pekee ndio huhesabiwa.

MESSAGE: ⚠️ If the initial and current decks have different customer counts, the dashboard says so — recovery would be overstated by the difference.
SW-MESSAGE: ⚠️ Kama orodha ya awali na ya sasa zina idadi tofauti ya wateja, dashibodi itakuambia — urejeshaji ungeonekana mkubwa kuliko ukweli.

MESSAGE: 🗂️ Every stage of the loan pipeline is here — Unassigned, Assigned, Assessed, Pending Approval, Approved and Disbursed.
SW-MESSAGE: 🗂️ Kila hatua ya mchakato wa mkopo iko hapa — Unassigned, Assigned, Assessed, Pending Approval, Approved na Disbursed.

MESSAGE: 👀 "All stages" is the default — you no longer have to know which stage an application reached before you can find it.
SW-MESSAGE: 👀 "Hatua zote" ndiyo chaguo-msingi — huhitaji tena kujua hatua ya maombi kabla ya kuyatafuta.

MESSAGE: 🔎 Filter by stage or team, or search by docket number, name or contact.
SW-MESSAGE: 🔎 Chuja kwa hatua au timu, au tafuta kwa namba ya jalada, jina au namba ya simu.

MESSAGE: 📞 Register complaints from calls, walk-ins or any external party — with category, channel and status.
SW-MESSAGE: 📞 Sajili malalamiko kutoka simu, wageni au mtu yeyote wa nje — pamoja na aina, njia na hali.

MESSAGE: ✅ When a complaint is handled, fill "Ufumbuzi / Resolution" and switch its status to Resolved.
SW-MESSAGE: ✅ Lalamiko likishughulikiwa, jaza "Ufumbuzi / Resolution" na ubadilishe hali yake kuwa Resolved.

MESSAGE: 🕓 Every save is tracked — open a complaint to see who registered, edited or resolved it, and when.
SW-MESSAGE: 🕓 Kila uhifadhi hufuatiliwa — fungua lalamiko kuona nani alisajili, alihariri au alifunga, na lini.

MESSAGE: 📅 Use the From/To dates to audit complaints for any period — categories and channels are fixed lists so they can be counted.
SW-MESSAGE: 📅 Tumia tarehe za From/To kukagua malalamiko ya kipindi chochote — aina na njia ni orodha maalum ili ziweze kuhesabiwa.

MESSAGE: 📆 The Mon–Fri tabs hold each weekday's installments — "leo" marks today.
SW-MESSAGE: 📆 Vichupo vya Jumatatu–Ijumaa vina marejesho ya kila siku — "leo" huonyesha leo.

MESSAGE: 🟢 PAID and OVERPAID count the full installment; UNDERPAID counts expected − arrears; UNPAID counts zero.
SW-MESSAGE: 🟢 PAID na OVERPAID huhesabu rejesho kamili; UNDERPAID huhesabu inayotarajiwa − deni; UNPAID huhesabu sifuri.

MESSAGE: ⏰ Early-collection officers are judged on TOMORROW's (kesho) list — push it before the day ends.
SW-MESSAGE: ⏰ Maafisa wa ukusanyaji wa mapema hupimwa kwa orodha ya KESHO — ifanyie kazi kabla siku haijaisha.

MESSAGE: 📤 Upload each day's sheet under its own date — "kesho" is worked out from the date, never uploaded twice.
SW-MESSAGE: 📤 Pakia laha ya kila siku kwa tarehe yake — "kesho" hupatikana kutoka tarehe, hakuna kupakia mara mbili.

MESSAGE: 👆 Tap any row to log a follow-up for that customer without leaving this screen.
SW-MESSAGE: 👆 Gusa mstari wowote kuandika ufuatiliaji wa mteja bila kuondoka kwenye skrini hii.

MESSAGE: 🤝 Defaulters are auto-assigned to BIKE, MANAGER or GMO depending on how long they have been overdue.
SW-MESSAGE: 🤝 Wadaiwa hupangiwa kiotomatiki kwa BIKE, MANAGER au GMO kutegemea muda ambao wamechelewa.

MESSAGE: ⚙️ The rotation — days per bucket, grace weeks, chronic cycle — is set by the ADMIN in Settings.
SW-MESSAGE: ⚙️ Mzunguko — siku kwa kila kundi, wiki za neema, mzunguko sugu — hupangwa na ADMIN kwenye Settings.

MESSAGE: 🔁 Ownership moves on a clock on purpose: the same officer calling the same person every week stops working.
SW-MESSAGE: 🔁 Umiliki hubadilika kwa saa kwa makusudi: afisa yuleyule kumpigia mteja yuleyule kila wiki huacha kufanya kazi.

MESSAGE: 🚲 BIKE is the team's dedicated recovery officer — set per team in Teams & Staff.
SW-MESSAGE: 🚲 BIKE ni afisa maalum wa urejeshaji wa timu — hupangwa kwa kila timu kwenye Teams & Staff.

MESSAGE: 📅 Each defaulter appears on two weekly days — their disbursement weekday and three days later (Sunday rolls to Monday).
SW-MESSAGE: 📅 Kila mdaiwa huonekana siku mbili kwa wiki — siku ya kutolewa mkopo na siku tatu baadaye (Jumapili huhamia Jumatatu).

MESSAGE: 🚨 CHRONIC means past the grace weeks; EXPIRED is still inside the grace period.
SW-MESSAGE: 🚨 CHRONIC inamaanisha amepita wiki za neema; EXPIRED bado yuko ndani ya kipindi cha neema.

MESSAGE: 🗓️ A customer with no disbursement date cannot be placed on a weekday — they sit under the "No date" tab so nobody is lost.
SW-MESSAGE: 🗓️ Mteja asiye na tarehe ya kutolewa mkopo hawezi kupangwa siku — yuko chini ya kichupo cha "No date" ili asipotee.

MESSAGE: 👆 Click a row to open the customer's profile and log what happened on the visit.
SW-MESSAGE: 👆 Bofya mstari kufungua wasifu wa mteja na kuandika kilichotokea kwenye ziara.

MESSAGE: 👥 Every GMO, MANAGER and BIKE officer with their own expected-defaulter book — daily for the morning meeting, weekly for the record.
SW-MESSAGE: 👥 Kila afisa wa GMO, MANAGER na BIKE na orodha yake ya wadaiwa wanaotarajiwa — ya kila siku kwa kikao cha asubuhi, ya wiki kwa kumbukumbu.

MESSAGE: 🧮 Rec % = recovered ÷ initial. Daily measures against that day's initial deck; weekly against Monday's.
SW-MESSAGE: 🧮 Rec % = kilichorejeshwa ÷ deni la awali. Ya kila siku hupima dhidi ya orodha ya awali ya siku hiyo; ya wiki dhidi ya Jumatatu.

MESSAGE: ✉️ The email button sends THIS week's report to the admin address — only when you press it, never on a schedule.
SW-MESSAGE: ✉️ Kitufe cha barua pepe hutuma ripoti ya WIKI HII kwa anwani ya admin — pale unapobofya tu, si kwa ratiba.

MESSAGE: 📱 The same list is on the phone: officers see who is assigned, leaders see their own book first.
SW-MESSAGE: 📱 Orodha hiyohiyo iko kwenye simu: maafisa huona nani amepangiwa, viongozi huona orodha yao kwanza.

MESSAGE: 📱 Click any defaulter to see their full history and log a status.
SW-MESSAGE: 📱 Bofya mdaiwa yeyote kuona historia yake kamili na kuandika hali.

MESSAGE: 🤝 AMETOA AHADI requires a promise date — the promise then appears automatically in Promise to Pay.
SW-MESSAGE: 🤝 AMETOA AHADI inahitaji tarehe ya ahadi — kisha ahadi huonekana kiotomatiki kwenye Promise to Pay.

MESSAGE: 📵 ANA NAMBA NYINGINE stores the customer's new number so the next officer reaches them.
SW-MESSAGE: 📵 ANA NAMBA NYINGINE huhifadhi namba mpya ya mteja ili afisa anayefuata amfikie.

MESSAGE: 🧾 History is kept forever per REF# — every officer's comment stays with the customer, visible to everyone.
SW-MESSAGE: 🧾 Historia huhifadhiwa milele kwa kila REF# — maoni ya kila afisa hubaki na mteja, yanaonekana kwa kila mtu.

MESSAGE: 📤 This list is rebuilt every time you upload Defaulters Current — what officers typed is never overwritten.
SW-MESSAGE: 📤 Orodha hii hujengwa upya kila unapopakia Defaulters Current — kile maafisa walichoandika hakifutwi kamwe.

MESSAGE: 🤝 Every AMETOA AHADI follow-up lands here automatically, with its promise date and amount.
SW-MESSAGE: 🤝 Kila ufuatiliaji wa AMETOA AHADI huja hapa kiotomatiki, pamoja na tarehe ya ahadi na kiasi.

MESSAGE: 📅 Overdue promises sort first — follow them before anything else.
SW-MESSAGE: 📅 Ahadi zilizopitwa na wakati hupangwa kwanza — zifuatilie kabla ya kitu kingine.

MESSAGE: ✅ CLEARED means the customer no longer appears in the current defaulters list — the promise was kept.
SW-MESSAGE: ✅ CLEARED inamaanisha mteja hayupo tena kwenye orodha ya wadaiwa wa sasa — ahadi ilitimizwa.

MESSAGE: 💰 "Arrears before" beside "Arrears now" is how you see whether a promise was actually kept.
SW-MESSAGE: 💰 "Deni kabla" pamoja na "Deni sasa" ndiyo njia ya kuona kama ahadi ilitimizwa kweli.

MESSAGE: 🧑‍💼 The matrix counts follow-ups per officer, split by status — daily proof of field and call work.
SW-MESSAGE: 🧑‍💼 Jedwali huhesabu ufuatiliaji kwa kila afisa, kwa hali — uthibitisho wa kila siku wa kazi ya uwandani na simu.

MESSAGE: 📋 Under the summaries is the LOG — every individual follow-up. The counts are only an index into it.
SW-MESSAGE: 📋 Chini ya muhtasari kuna KUMBUKUMBU — kila ufuatiliaji mmoja mmoja. Hesabu ni njia ya kuufikia tu.

MESSAGE: 📅 Change From/To to audit any period, then filter by team, officer or status.
SW-MESSAGE: 📅 Badilisha From/To kukagua kipindi chochote, kisha chuja kwa timu, afisa au hali.

MESSAGE: 🚩 Payments that are not clean multiples of TZS 500 / 1,000 are flagged automatically from every Received Payments upload.
SW-MESSAGE: 🚩 Malipo yasiyo mafungu kamili ya TZS 500 / 1,000 huwekewa alama kiotomatiki kutoka kila upakiaji wa Received Payments.

MESSAGE: 🔍 Verify each flagged transaction with the field officer — the sender name and transaction ID are shown.
SW-MESSAGE: 🔍 Thibitisha kila muamala uliowekwa alama na afisa wa uwandani — jina la mtumaji na namba ya muamala huonyeshwa.

MESSAGE: ⚖️ Load a defaulter by REF# to preview the fine, principal remaining and total demand before issuing anything.
SW-MESSAGE: ⚖️ Pakia mdaiwa kwa REF# kuona faini, deni la msingi lililobaki na jumla ya madai kabla ya kutoa chochote.

MESSAGE: 🧮 The fine starts two weeks after the first missed installment — 2% for loans disbursed in 2024 or earlier, 5% after that.
SW-MESSAGE: 🧮 Faini huanza wiki mbili baada ya rejesho la kwanza kukosekana — 2% kwa mikopo ya 2024 na kabla, 5% baadaye.

MESSAGE: 🖨️ Issuing a notice prints the full Swahili demand letter with the company letterhead, stamp and signature.
SW-MESSAGE: 🖨️ Kutoa notisi huchapisha barua kamili ya madai kwa Kiswahili yenye kichwa, muhuri na sahihi ya kampuni.

MESSAGE: 🔖 Every notice gets its own reference (Kumb.Na.) — that is how it is cited afterwards in a follow-up or a handover.
SW-MESSAGE: 🔖 Kila notisi hupata kumbukumbu yake (Kumb.Na.) — ndiyo hutumika baadaye kwenye ufuatiliaji au makabidhiano.

MESSAGE: 🔁 Only defaulters with 4+ missed installments (DC) are eligible — rescheduling someone who missed one payment is just a discount.
SW-MESSAGE: 🔁 Ni wadaiwa wenye marejesho 4+ yaliyokoswa (DC) tu wanaostahili — kumpangia upya aliyekosa rejesho moja ni punguzo tu.

MESSAGE: 🧮 Start from the customer's REF#: every figure is computed from their own arrears, never typed by hand.
SW-MESSAGE: 🧮 Anza na REF# ya mteja: kila tarakimu huhesabiwa kutoka deni lake, si kuandikwa kwa mkono.

MESSAGE: 📅 The preview shows the exact weekly schedule, rounded to TZS 500, with the last installment absorbing the rounding.
SW-MESSAGE: 📅 Muhtasari huonyesha ratiba kamili ya wiki, iliyokadiriwa hadi TZS 500, na rejesho la mwisho hubeba baki.

MESSAGE: ✅ Offers stay PENDING until an approver named in Settings approves or rejects them — a rejection must carry a reason.
SW-MESSAGE: ✅ Ofa hubaki PENDING hadi mwidhinishaji aliyetajwa kwenye Settings aidhinishe au akatae — kukataa lazima kuwe na sababu.

MESSAGE: 📈 Analysts are scored on their Count 1–6 book (paid fewer than 6 of 12) and on sales — the Overall % judges them.
SW-MESSAGE: 📈 Wachambuzi hupimwa kwa orodha yao ya Count 1–6 (waliolipa chini ya 6 kati ya 12) na mauzo — Overall % ndiyo huwapima.

MESSAGE: 🎯 Cleared and Reduced are wins; Bad means arrears rose; Static means nothing changed.
SW-MESSAGE: 🎯 Cleared na Reduced ni ushindi; Bad inamaanisha deni liliongezeka; Static inamaanisha hakuna kilichobadilika.

MESSAGE: 🗂️ The portfolio under the scorecard is TODAY's call list — someone who started defaulting on Wednesday appears there.
SW-MESSAGE: 🗂️ Orodha chini ya alama ni ya simu za LEO — aliyeanza kudaiwa Jumatano huonekana hapo.

MESSAGE: 🧑‍✈️ One section per supervisory role — a leader's real performance is the roll-up across ALL the teams they carry.
SW-MESSAGE: 🧑‍✈️ Sehemu moja kwa kila wadhifa — utendaji halisi wa kiongozi ni jumla ya timu ZOTE anazobeba.

MESSAGE: 👀 Teams with nobody named in a role collect under "(unassigned)" — an unstaffed role is exactly what this should show you.
SW-MESSAGE: 👀 Timu zisizo na mtu kwenye wadhifa hukusanyika chini ya "(unassigned)" — wadhifa usio na mtu ndicho hasa hii inapaswa kukuonyesha.

MESSAGE: 🗓️ The week runs Monday initial → week-end current — upload both for the complete picture.
SW-MESSAGE: 🗓️ Wiki huanzia Jumatatu ya awali → mwisho wa wiki wa sasa — pakia zote mbili kupata picha kamili.

MESSAGE: 📑 Five sections per team: Sales, Count 1–6, Collection, Recovery and Ongezeko la deni.
SW-MESSAGE: 📑 Sehemu tano kwa kila timu: Mauzo, Count 1–6, Makusanyo, Urejeshaji na Ongezeko la deni.

MESSAGE: ➖ Ongezeko la deni: green = debt fell (recovered); red = debt rose during the week.
SW-MESSAGE: ➖ Ongezeko la deni: kijani = deni lilipungua (limerejeshwa); nyekundu = deni liliongezeka wiki hii.

MESSAGE: 🧮 PAR % = at-risk arrears ÷ outstanding balance of defaulters.
SW-MESSAGE: 🧮 PAR % = deni lililo hatarini ÷ salio linalodaiwa la wadaiwa.

MESSAGE: 📊 The principal bands show where the overdue money is concentrated by loan size — that is the one the meeting acts on.
SW-MESSAGE: 📊 Makundi ya mtaji huonyesha wapi fedha za madeni zimejikita kwa ukubwa wa mkopo — ndiyo kikao hufanyia kazi.

MESSAGE: 📅 The ageing bands answer a different question: how LONG each customer has been overdue.
SW-MESSAGE: 📅 Makundi ya muda hujibu swali jingine: kwa MUDA GANI kila mteja amechelewa.

MESSAGE: 📽️ A full-screen slideshow for the office TV — it plays like PowerPoint and the figures are live, not a screenshot.
SW-MESSAGE: 📽️ Onyesho la skrini nzima kwa TV ya ofisi — hucheza kama PowerPoint na tarakimu ni za moja kwa moja, si picha.

MESSAGE: 🎯 Untick the segments this meeting does not need, and scope the whole deck to a single team.
SW-MESSAGE: 🎯 Ondoa sehemu ambazo kikao hiki hakihitaji, na elekeza onyesho lote kwa timu moja.

MESSAGE: ⌨️ Esc exits, ← / → change slides, and the seconds per slide are set right beside the play button.
SW-MESSAGE: ⌨️ Esc hutoka, ← / → hubadilisha slaidi, na sekunde kwa kila slaidi hupangwa karibu na kitufe cha kucheza.

MESSAGE: 🧭 Team names here must match the uploaded reports exactly — everything else joins on them.
SW-MESSAGE: 🧭 Majina ya timu hapa lazima yafanane kabisa na ripoti zilizopakiwa — kila kitu kingine hujiunga navyo.

MESSAGE: 🔑 The team CODE is what field officers sign in with on the phone. Change it and every handset on that team is released at once.
SW-MESSAGE: 🔑 MSIMBO wa timu ndio maafisa huingia nao kwenye simu. Ukiubadilisha, simu zote za timu hiyo hukatwa mara moja.

MESSAGE: ➕ ADMINs can add teams, edit the leader for each role, and edit which tabs each ROLE can see.
SW-MESSAGE: ➕ ADMIN wanaweza kuongeza timu, kuhariri kiongozi wa kila wadhifa, na kuhariri vichupo ambavyo kila WADHIFA huona.

MESSAGE: ☎️ Call agents are listed by their agent ID from the application reports — name the people behind each id here.
SW-MESSAGE: ☎️ Mawakala wa simu huorodheshwa kwa agent ID kutoka ripoti za maombi — taja watu walio nyuma ya kila id hapa.

MESSAGE: 📤 Pick what you are uploading, then the file — the importer reads the sheet you confirm on screen.
SW-MESSAGE: 📤 Chagua unachopakia, kisha faili — mfumo husoma karatasi unayothibitisha skrini.

MESSAGE: 👀 "Already uploaded today" shows what is in and what is still missing — check it BEFORE the meeting, not after.
SW-MESSAGE: 👀 "Already uploaded today" huonyesha kilichopo na kinachokosekana — angalia KABLA ya kikao, si baada.

MESSAGE: ♻️ Re-uploading the same date REPLACES it — the newest upload wins and the old copy stays underneath as history.
SW-MESSAGE: ♻️ Kupakia tena tarehe ileile HUBADILISHA — upakiaji mpya hushinda na wa zamani hubaki chini kama historia.

MESSAGE: 🕗 Upload Defaulters Current daily. Monday's Initial is the recovery baseline for the whole week.
SW-MESSAGE: 🕗 Pakia Defaulters Current kila siku. Ya awali ya Jumatatu ndiyo kianzio cha urejeshaji cha wiki nzima.

MESSAGE: 🔄 Uploading Defaulters Current also rebuilds the officers' working list in the app — nothing they typed is lost.
SW-MESSAGE: 🔄 Kupakia Defaulters Current pia hujenga upya orodha ya kazi ya maafisa kwenye programu — hakuna walichoandika kinachopotea.

MESSAGE: 🔑 Access codes work like passwords — each user gets a code, a role, their teams and exactly the tabs they should see.
SW-MESSAGE: 🔑 Misimbo ya kuingia hufanya kazi kama nywila — kila mtumiaji hupata msimbo, wadhifa, timu zake, na vichupo hasa anavyopaswa kuona.

MESSAGE: ♻️ A code can be CHANGED at any time — that is how you rotate one that has been shared around.
SW-MESSAGE: ♻️ Msimbo unaweza KUBADILISHWA wakati wowote — ndiyo njia ya kubadilisha ulioshirikishwa hovyo.

MESSAGE: 📱 Field officer accounts: switching one off cuts that handset immediately and keeps their call history; deleting removes the history too.
SW-MESSAGE: 📱 Akaunti za maafisa: kuizima hukata simu hiyo mara moja na kuhifadhi historia; kufuta huondoa na historia.

MESSAGE: 🧹 "Clean old reports" frees space by date and report type — Check first counts the rows without deleting anything.
SW-MESSAGE: 🧹 "Kusafisha ripoti za zamani" hufungua nafasi kwa tarehe na aina ya ripoti — Check huhesabu bila kufuta chochote.

MESSAGE: 💾 The storage tiles show how much the database holds and how fast it is growing at your current upload rate.
SW-MESSAGE: 💾 Vigae vya hifadhi huonyesha data iliyopo na kasi ya ukuaji kwa kiwango chako cha upakiaji.

MESSAGE: ⏱️ Auto-refresh, presentation seconds, sales targets, the assignment rotation and the restructuring policy all live here.
SW-MESSAGE: ⏱️ Auto-refresh, sekunde za onyesho, malengo ya mauzo, mzunguko wa ugawaji na sera ya kupanga upya vyote viko hapa.

MESSAGE: ✉️ Set ADMIN_EMAIL here so the weekly Exp.Def report has somewhere to go.
SW-MESSAGE: ✉️ Weka ADMIN_EMAIL hapa ili ripoti ya wiki ya Exp.Def iwe na pa kwenda.

MESSAGE: ☎️ Five views of the same week: by category, by outcome, by team, by day and by officer.
SW-MESSAGE: ☎️ Mitazamo mitano ya wiki ileile: kwa aina, kwa matokeo, kwa timu, kwa siku na kwa afisa.

MESSAGE: 🎯 Portfolio % is the number that matters — 80 calls mean little if none were to customers who owe money.
SW-MESSAGE: 🎯 Portfolio % ndiyo tarakimu muhimu — simu 80 hazina maana kama hakuna iliyokwenda kwa wanaodaiwa.

MESSAGE: 💰 Commission is earned by PEOPLE, from two different jobs: recovery pays a % of what arrears fell by, early collection pays a flat amount per PAID/OVERPAID client.
SW-MESSAGE: 💰 Kamisheni hupatikana na WATU, kutoka kazi mbili: urejeshaji hulipa % ya kupungua kwa deni, ukusanyaji wa mapema hulipa kiasi kamili kwa kila mteja wa PAID/OVERPAID.

MESSAGE: 📅 Both are summed day by day — a customer who recovered on Tuesday earned Tuesday's commission even if they slipped back on Thursday.
SW-MESSAGE: 📅 Zote hujumlishwa siku kwa siku — mteja aliyerejesha Jumanne alileta kamisheni ya Jumanne hata kama alirudi nyuma Alhamisi.

MESSAGE: ⚙️ ADMINs set the rates right on this page — type them and the numbers move immediately.
SW-MESSAGE: ⚙️ ADMIN hupanga viwango hapahapa — viandike na tarakimu hubadilika mara moja.
